opening.argument: The video promotes a high-return crypto earning opportunity by presenting Prime DeFi as a route to 60%–120% or more in yearly passive income, while describing the method as teaching investors to earn “60 or more passively safely.” It reinforces that solicitation through a testimonial claiming that someone started with five thousand dollars and earned two thousand dollars in three months. The promotion directs viewers toward free training tied to recurring crypto-income claims, then adds a profit assurance that Dan Ryder will make sure participants are in profit. Finally, the host urges viewers to “get started today,” making clear that this is a call to participate rather than a neutral analysis of DeFi.
